snippet.title: Minecraft in Tetris (Fan Game C::Reactris)
snippet.description:
"C::Reactris" is a free fan-made game that combines the gameplay of Tetris with the rich features of Minecraft.
The "C" in the title stands for various words such as "Chain" "Create" "Chaos" "Clear", which are related to the game's mechanics and themes.
Two colons, which is actually four dots means four-cell tetromino used in Tetris, and it's also the scope resolution operator in C++.
"Reactris" is a combination of "React" and "tris", representing both the idea of reaction and the blocks in the game.
The game can also be referred to as "Minecraftris" or "C4R" for short.

# Download Links
hdms.itch.io/c4r
Windows, Linux and Android platforms are supported.
Language support English, Chinese and Japanese.

Video Production: Fuwuwuwu
Animation effects: Fuwuwuwu, RainbowRoad1

Tools used: Manim (vector animation) Pr (video editing)
